sub_sector: Sheet-metal parts for white goods and lighting
the_problem: Socolor S.A., a La Plata metalworks making sheet parts for white-goods and lighting makers, saw sales fall up to 40% from 2024, ran at 30% of capacity in 2025 and only 10% in early 2026.
the_decision: Owner Mariano Nicolicchia chose a total halt of activity: "La decisión del cierre fue el corte total de la actividad. Tomar la decisión fue muy duro y difícil, somos una familia que generó siempre mucho trabajo". His reason: "Las ventas comenzaron a bajar de forma exagerada, hasta un 40%, y ya en 2025 producíamos un 30%", and by early 2026 the plant produced 10% and was "imposible de soportar".
the_outcome: Plant on calle 526 closed after 22+ years; all workers dismissed (owners had warned over 20 households would lose income); output fell from full capacity to 10%.
